name: Metlen Construction Single Member Société Anonyme
summary: METKA S.A. GROUP OF COMPANIES engages in the construction of public and private sector projects. It operates through Construction, PPPs and Concessions, and Facility Management segments. The company constructs transport, building, and social and environmental infrastructure projects; develops, finances, and operates PPP and concession projects; and provides facility management, such as technical, operations and maintenance, and other support services to various customers. It serves government ministries, organizations and bodies, infrastructure development and concession operating companies, real estate developers, hotel operators, and commercial property owners and developers.
